name: NHS — supporting an autistic child
description: NHS public guidance about understanding an autistic child's individual needs, communication, sensory environment, routines, socialising and routes to practical support.
intended_use: Use as a national health-information starting point for parents and carers supporting an autistic child, including needs-led practical support.
audience_or_context: Parents and carers looking for general UK NHS information; education and local-service details can vary by nation and locality.
limitations: The page is autism-specific and does not replace individual assessment where a child has health, safeguarding or urgent support needs.
Education and local authority pathways differ across the UK, so linked local-service steps must be checked for the reader's jurisdiction.
conflicts_of_interest: NHS public information; ND Oracle does not treat inclusion as a personalised recommendation.
